caseNameFull: B. S. Wheeler and M. S. Galasso v. Galen D. Pue
attorneys: Maury for defendant in error in support of the motion. Mr. James H. Baldwin for plaintiff in error in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Motion to dismiss granted under § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 937), for lack. of jurisdiction. Treating the writ of error as an application for certiorari, the certiorari is denied under the authority of Taubel, etc., Co. v. Fox, 264 U. S. 426, 429; Liberty Bank v. Bear, 265 U. S. 365, 369. Mr. H. L.
